shortDescription: Submits generic command to ISC KEA server on target

options.name: arguments
options.description: The arguments sent along with the command, if any. Use V({}) to send an empty arguments dict/object instead of omitting it.

options.name: command
options.description: The name of the command to send, for example V(status-get).

options.name: rv_changed
options.description: A list of C(result) codes to indicate success and changed system state. Omit this for most acquisition commands. Set it to V([0]) for O(command=lease4-del) and similar which return changed system state that way. Any C(result) codes not listed in either O(rv_unchanged) or O(rv_changed) are interpreted as indicating an error result. O(rv_unchanged) has precedence over O(rv_changed) if a result code is in both lists.

options.name: rv_unchanged
options.description: A list of C(result) codes to indicate success but unchanged system state. Set this to V([0]) for most acquisition commands. Use V([3]) for O(command=lease4-del) and similar which have a separate code for this. Any C(result) codes not listed in either O(rv_unchanged) or O(rv_changed) are interpreted as indicating an error result. O(rv_unchanged) has precedence over O(rv_changed) if a result code is in both lists.

options.name: socket
options.description: The full pathname of the Unix Domain Socket to connect to. The default value is suitable for C(kea-dhcp4-server) on Debian trixie. This module directly interfaces using UDS; the HTTP wrappers are not supported.
